identity.name: Coinbase International Exchange Sandisk Corp. Perp

about.description: SNDK is a single-stock perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking Sandisk Corp., margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 10× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
